info.name: Sphinx API — search → results → verify
info.description:
Reproduces the hotel booking chain end to end.

Run the three requests IN ORDER. Each one saves what the next needs (cursor, then offer_id) into collection variables automatically, so you never copy/paste ids by hand.

BEFORE YOU START: open the Variables tab and paste your bearer token into `token`. Nothing is stored in this file.

WHY IT EXISTS: offer ids expire within minutes, so a verify call cannot be tested on its own — it has to follow a live search. This collection makes that a three-click sequence.

variable.description: PASTE YOUR BEARER TOKEN HERE. Left empty on purpose so this file carries no credentials.
Which hotel to pick an offer from

request.description: Optional. Confirms the token works before anything else. Expect HTTP 200.

exec: // Saves the cursor so request 2 can just be clicked.
console.log('NO CURSOR in the response — cannot continue');

request.description: Starts an async search. Returns only a cursor — no offers yet.

exec: // Picks an offer for the hotel named in `hotel_name_filter` and saves its id.
// IMPORTANT: an EMPTY page does not mean 'no results'. Sphinx streams
// suppliers in parallel, so early pages are often empty while slower
// suppliers are still answering. Just SEND THIS REQUEST AGAIN — the
// cursor updates itself each time — until offers appear.
console.log('must_verify  : ' + hit.must_verify + '   <-- false means verify is NOT required');
console.log('Search finished and no match for "' + want + '". Clear hotel_name_filter to take any offer.');
console.log('No match on this page — SEND THIS REQUEST AGAIN (the cursor has advanced).');

request.description: Fetches a page of offers. Re-send until you see offers (empty pages are normal — the search is still streaming). Keep going until `cursor` is null to see everything.

item.name: 3. Verify — GET /hotels/verify   <-- THIS IS THE FAILING CALL

exec: console.log('SERVER ERROR — this is the response to send to the Sphinx team.');

request.description:
Re-confirms the offer picked in request 2.

EXPECTED: HTTP 200 with the offer, its payment_terms and cancellation_fees now loaded.

ACTUAL (as of the last check): HTTP 500 with an 'Undefined array key 0' error from inside Sphinx's own EtripV2Client. Copy the whole response body from the Body tab — that is what the Sphinx team needs.
